reviews.classification: historical request/consumer coverage; current authority and scope correction
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full724-line coverage-map content review reads every root field, all UVS01–UVS15 rows with original quoted requests, historical locators, source-owner claims, missing consumers, examples, dependencies, delivery scope and acceptance, plus all27inspected-input records. Compact lossless row groups were actually read. Original JSON bytes/schema are retained. Historical source locators/hashes/read reports do not renew source, runtime or every USER_VISION quote verification. Selected current USER_VISION headings independently retain personal-method/incomplete-transmission direction and preservation of vanilla; old549/771line offsets no longer locate them. The map-reported earlier family/genealogy direct-chat quotation remains attributed to that map’s provenance, not independently authenticated or inserted as a newly verified user quote.

F2: Preserve UVS01learner-owned method, willing teaching, attribution and real paid NPC use; UVS02actual agreed terms, custody, finite payer budgets and closure across reconvergence; UVS03independent actors with means, travel, contact and known report/expiry; UVS04witness/jurisdiction-specific reputation without automatic kin guilt or universal moral meter; UVS05willing ready participants, actual bodies/sources/wounds/stock and paid rest. These are distinct consumers, not permission labels or new mandatory global frameworks. Their dated source subset claims require current producer/state/consumer checks if implementation is selected.

F3: UVS06arc, career, retirement, succession and bodily death stay separate; competence does not silently age or kill someone. UVS07preserved vanilla does not restore the retired one-realm/prestige milestone. UVS08four worked groups do not replace the historical33parent/15strand/7ending proposal ledger, nor establish completion. Current PROJECT prioritizes Klein/HP and holds Frontier/Mistglass as test beds with no new depth; this map authorizes no society campaign dispatch. UVS09voice/known context differs from secret truth and actual commitment closure; UVS10kinship/upbringing/body/memory/property/romance eligibility stay independent, world-local and optional until selected. No fixed childhood wait or surname-derived power is adopted.

F4: UVS11a paid inquiry/report supplies actual knowledge, not household rights, genealogy truth, appraised power or a new ending. UVS12cumulative arc/career/institution/retirement/departure outcomes differ from forced life/world endings or extraction; preserve actual choice and aftermath. UVS13eligible preparation and frozen weighted outcome differ from immutable ancestry/consent; preview/reload must not imply fresh outcomes or hidden resource advance, but the map does not verify current RNG/write atomicity. UVS14reuse existing typed ownership/causal primitives with actual terms/participants/evidence and an ending projection, rather than a parallel bag/clock/reward ledger; contrasting chronologies validate without flattening differences. UVS15motive, knowledge, means, access and history distinguish retaliation/reconciliation; source/body/identity changes need their actual mechanism. Exceptional superior powers remain possible within actual scope, not a universal ban.

F5: Keep SB01open chronicle and SB02chaptered family career as original proposals; family/romance/party/law/generations are palettes, not new universal gates. All required/optional classifications belong to the dated selected planning pack, not present authorization. Current AD42makes human review optional; document graph/arithmetic/quote checks cannot stand in for current native/build/save behavior. Historical S2skill wave/current-owner labels are superseded by PROJECT. No novel body/source-code reread, runtime implementation/test/build/browser, new worker/acquisition, personal-save access, deletion/move, commit or push occurs.
reviews.evidence: All724lines represented in complete compact root/row/input records actually read; selected current PROJECT and USER_VISION headings checked. No underlying source body reread or runtime proof.
reviews.reopen: Retain historical proposals; selected future implementation needs current producer/state/consumer and source-qualified requests. No current Frontier expansion dispatch.

folds.heading: ## Request-map content and current authority B617
folds.body:
B617fully reviews every field of [COVERAGE.json](COVERAGE.json), UVS01–UVS15 and all27historical inspected inputs. Preserve their distinct teaching/ownership/paid-actor/knowledge/kinship/party/ending/causal/RNG/identity consumers, rather than collapsing them into a social score or new global framework. SB01/SB02remain original planning alternatives with actual means, consent, knowledge, retained costs and useful aftermath. A learner’s real procedure, a title, a source, property, family standing and memory remain different carriers. Career/retirement/succession do not force bodily death or a world reset.

The old source offsets, S2wave, required alternatives and33parent/15strand/7ending tally describe the2026-10-05planning pack. They establish no fresh source or delivery proof. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../../PROJECT.md) prioritizes Klein/HP and keeps Frontier/Mistglass as test beds with no new depth; this coverage map launches no campaign. Vanilla preservation stays useful, while the one-realm/prestige milestone is retired. Human review is optional under AD42; static graphs/arithmetic do not exercise native/save behavior. The map’s reported earlier direct-chat family quotation is preserved as reported provenance, without inventing an independently verified USER_VISION locator or acceptance.
